d: Chestnut brown hair is styled in two messy buns with long braids framing the face and choppy bangs, accented by yellow hairpins. Large, sparkling teal eyes convey a cheerful, youthful expression on a face with the appearance of a young teenager. A slender build is dressed in a white cropped t-shirt with red sleeves and a graphic print, paired with loose-fitting blue denim jeans and pink and teal sneakers. Signature accessories include a pink jacket tied around the waist, a large teal backpack filled with brown boxing gloves, and white hand wraps.
